categories_thin: Architecture, surveying and environmental consulting: still very thin after targeted re-searches - two architects and two land-surveying records in directory indexes, and no environmental firm found in town.
Management consulting: three directory-only names; Yellow Pages blocked direct access, so none could be confirmed on a page I could open.

Independent physicians (non-dental): the town's medical care is dominated by large systems (Hackensack Meridian Raritan Bay, Consensus Health, MetroDoc), which are excluded, so only a handful of independent practices could be confirmed.
IT / software firms: only computer-repair-scale businesses surfaced; no software or managed-services company with a Perth Amboy office was confirmed.
Title agencies: three entries, two at the same 316 State St address and one with only a placeholder website, so the number actually trading is uncertain.
Independent insurance agencies: six entries, but several are directory-only and carrier-branded agency pages (State Farm, Allstate) were excluded by rule, so more independents may exist unseen.
caveats: Revision rule applied consistently to brand/multi-office businesses: excluded are franchise systems and franchise-branded offices (Remedy/EmployBridge, Partners Personnel, the Lupo Group under eXp Realty), a ~30-site regional PT chain (SportsMed), multi-office statewide or multi-state law firms (Ginarte, Garces Grabler & LeBrocq, CourtLaw with ten offices), a national FQHC with several sites (Central Jersey Medical Center) and public/hospital systems. Kept are owner-operated practices and small firms with at most two offices in central NJ (e.g. Starkman Firm, Martin Kane & Kuper, Crown Rehab, Petra Best with two in-zone offices).

Removed in revision after verification: The BMA Dojo (its own site places it in Edison, not Perth Amboy), Rao Loder (New Providence practice), Perth Amboy Tax Advisors (72 State St not substantiated as a tax office), Remedy Intelligent Staffing (franchise), Partners Personnel, SportsMed Physical Therapy, Ginarte, Garces Grabler & LeBrocq, Central Jersey Medical Center and The Lupo Group (per the chain/multi-office rule above).
Elias & Gonzalez, LLC was merged into Gonzalez, Tullio & Blache, LLC - same suite, same phone, same attorney names; it is a former/alternate name of the same firm.
Google Maps served a lite view with about five results per query and disabled pagination, so map-derived categories are top-ranked rather than exhaustive.

Yellow Pages, Superpages, Manta, LocalityBiz, Cylex and similar sites returned HTTP 403 to this environment; OpenStreetMap Overpass endpoints were unreachable. Where an entry rests on such a site it is marked directory-only, and its details came from the search-result listing rather than a page I could open.
Many personal-care entries come from a single directory (BestProsInTown, which mirrors map data) with no phone number, so their active_evidence is 'directory only' - triage should confirm each.

Excluded by rule and noted here: Raritan Bay Medical Center and Hackensack Meridian outpatient rehab, Consensus Health Primary Care, MetroDoc Urgent Care, Middlesex County's George J. Otlowski mental-health center (government), Keller Williams By The Bay (franchise office), PureGym (chain), Raritan Bay Area YMCA (nonprofit association), Catholic Charities Metuchen immigration services (charity), Gonzalez & Associates Inc. at 786 King Georges Rd (Fords, outside town), The Club at Woodbridge, Remedi Day Spa (Staten Island).
data_gaps: The verifier's coverage note referred to a 'coverage.missing' list of nine businesses, but issues.json contained no such list - only the categories (two accounting firms, two salons, two PI firms, an insurance agency, a PT clinic, a pediatric practice). Those categories were re-searched and additions were made: Jiménez & Associates, B.A.S. Accounting MultiServices, Rose Beauty Salon, Carmen's Beauty HairStudio and Spa, Starkman Firm, Martin Kane & Kuper, Origin Insurance Group, Crown Rehab and Perth Amboy Pediatrics, plus surveyors and an architect from the thin-category re-search.
Phone numbers are Unknown for most salon, barber and nail entries because the source directory does not publish them and individual listing pages were not opened.

Website URLs are blank where no link was seen on a listing; they were never guessed. Some entries still lack a verified street address (Bose Tax, Perusa, Vas Law, Dr. Chavarria, Brandswaggin, Pablo's, Miguel Salon, Bless Cuts).
Two map-discovered businesses were deliberately dropped for privacy: DigiMark Direct (apartment address) and The Grooms Agency (residential street address). Confirm a business address before adding.
Absolute Access Title, Balance Yoga & Wellness Studio, Perth Amboy Martial Arts and Origin Insurance Group still need a phone or licence check to confirm current trading.

No official municipal or chamber business directory exists online for Perth Amboy, so no authoritative list could be used as a completeness baseline; the Statewide Hispanic Chamber of Commerce member directory is the only chamber source that surfaced a Perth Amboy business.
